tagline.en: An interactive world model built on Wan2.1 — animate an image into video while steering the camera through the scene.
tagline.zh: 构建在 Wan2.1 之上的交互式世界模型——把一张图片动画为视频,同时操控镜头在场景中穿行。

en: Astra is an interactive world model that turns a still image into video with camera control. You give it a starting frame and a camera direction, and it generates a clip that moves the viewpoint through the scene as if you were exploring it.

It is built on the open Wan2.1 text-to-video 1.3B backbone, adding a camera-control pathway on top so the generated motion follows your chosen viewpoint. This ties it to the image-to-video and interactive world-model family rather than plain prompt-to-clip generation.
In WorldFoundry, Astra runs inference through the shared Studio/API pipeline: provide an input image and a camera control, and it renders the resulting camera-driven video.
zh: Astra 是一个交互式世界模型,能把静态图片转成带相机控制的视频。你给它一帧起始画面和一个镜头方向,它就会生成一段让视点在场景中移动的片段,仿佛你正在其中探索。
它构建在开源的 Wan2.1 文生视频 1.3B 主干之上,并在其上叠加了相机控制通路,使生成的运动遵循你选定的视点。因此它属于图生视频与交互式世界模型这一类,而非单纯的提示词生成片段。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Astra 通过共享的 Studio/API pipeline 运行推理:给它一张输入图片和一个相机控制指令,它就会渲染出相应的镜头驱动视频。

whenToUse.en: Use Astra when you want to explore or 'walk into' a still image as a camera-controlled video — turning a single frame into an interactive, viewpoint-driven scene.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想把一张静态图片当作可控镜头的视频来探索、'走进'其中时,用 Astra——把单帧画面变成可交互、由视点驱动的场景。

notFor.en: Not a text-only video generator — it starts from an input image and a camera control, so it's not the tool for pure prompt-to-video without a source frame.
notFor.zh: 它不是纯文本视频生成器——它需要一张输入图片和相机控制作为起点,因此不适合没有源帧、只靠提示词生成视频的情形。

en: Image-to-video: animate a still frame into a moving scene
Built on the open Wan2.1 text-to-video 1.3B backbone
Runs through the shared Studio/API pipeline
zh: 交互式、可控镜头的世界模型
图生视频:让静态帧动起来成为移动的场景
构建在开源 Wan2.1 文生视频 1.3B 主干之上
通过共享 Studio/API pipeline 运行
